items.title: RHEL 10.0 and 9.6 repositories are being retired
items.summary: The RHEL 10.0 and RHEL 9.6 repositories are being retired from the main PostgreSQL RPM repository, and are moved to the PostgreSQL YUM archive .All PostgreSQL major versions that were built for these minor releases are available there, including PostgreSQL 18.The rolling EL-10 and EL-9 repository RPMs are not affected.If you are still on RHEL 10.0 or 9.6 (or on Rocky Linux / AlmaLinux 10.0 or 9.6), please either update to a newer minor release, or use the archive. The archived repositories section of the repository packages page generates the repository file and the install commands for each distribution version, architecture and PostgreSQL version: https://yum.postgresql.org/repopackages/#archivedreposPlease note that these repos will not receive further updates.If you have any questions, please either email to pgsql-pkg-yum@lists.postgresql.org, or create a ticket at our issue tracker .
